title: Melting Potatoes
description: Thick-cut Yukon Gold potatoes roasted in butter and herbs, then finished with stock and garlic until crisp-edged and creamy inside.
ingredients: 907 g Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and sliced about 2.5 cm thick
2 g fresh thyme leaves or 3 g chopped fresh rosemary
steps: Preheat the oven to 500°F (260°C) with the rack in the upper third. Toss the potatoes with butter, thyme or rosemary, salt, and pepper. Transfer to a 13 x 9 inch (33 x 23 cm) metal baking dish and arrange in a single layer. Do not use glass at this temperature.
Bake 15 minutes, flip the potatoes, then bake 15 minutes more.
Remove the dish from the oven and add the stock and garlic. Return to the oven at 500°F (260°C) until most of the stock is absorbed, about 15 minutes more.
Transfer to a serving platter and spoon any remaining pan liquid over the potatoes. Serve warm.
notes: Source: Real Simple. Volume and count measurements were converted to approximate gram weights.
